text:
sara: quick sync — we need to lock the rate/quotas schema for GA. main things: token accounting (esp streaming), per-route overrides, pricing-aligned fields for billing events. timeline: ship beta next week, GA in 6 weeks.
chen: +1. are we settling on tokens vs requests as the primary unit? customers want per-token billing but infra prefers request-based throttles.
sara: customers expect both. product idea: two-tier controls — rate_limit (requests/min) for protection and token_rate (tokens/sec) for cost alignment. defaults fall back to account-level.
karla: runtime note — enforcing token_rate in gateway needs us to estimate streaming tokens early. feasible if we count client-chosen max_tokens + prompt_length. we can enforce a soft token_budget and hard request cap.
mike: billing needs an unambiguous field in events: `billing_unit: "token"|"request"`, `units_consumed` (int). also need `token_accounting: "prompt+completion"|"completion-only"` because some customers charge differently.
eva: from a customer-ops angle, we need per-route tags so teams can attach pricing tiers. propose `route_quota_id` and `pricing_tier` metadata on route configs.
sara: good — propose schema snippet for feedback:```json
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "rate_limit_per_minute": 1200,
  "token_rate_per_second": 5000,
  "burst_tokens": 20000,
  "billing_unit": "token",
  "token_accounting": "prompt+completion",
  "pricing_tier": "standard|enterprise",
  "route_quota_id": "string"
}
```
chen: implementation concerns: `burst_tokens` relies on KV cache visibility across instances. for Dedicated we'll have shared quota manager; hosted needs fast Redis path. also need deterministic behavior for canary rollouts.
sara: launch criteria proposal (short): 1) end-to-end enforcement in hosted for requests+tokens, 2) billing events emitted with `billing_unit`+`units_consumed`, 3) per-route override UI in Console + per-route API, 4) migration plan for existing customers, 5) tests for streaming token accounting.
mike: billing tests: include spike scenarios + partial-stream refunds. need clarity on refunds for aborted streams. suggest `final_units_consumed` in invoice hook.
eva: migration note: default behaviour for legacy routes should map to `token_accounting: "prompt+completion"` and keep previous cost calculations for 30 days before switch. communicate via dashboard banner + email.
karla: ops SLA: enforce fail-open for low-tier in cross-region outage (i.e., degrade to request-based throttle only), and emit `quota_mode` in logs so SRE can tune.
chen: can we add a lightweight debug header for clients: `X-Quota-Status: {remaining_tokens, cooldown_seconds}` — useful for SDK UX.
sara: yes. add to launch checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: created rollout job `quota-schema/ci` — triggered on merge to main.
sara: final ask — product review tomorrow 10am to sign off on fields. if no objections I'll lock the schema by EOD today. :thumbsup:
mike: :thumbsup:
eva: ack
karla: ack
chen: will prepare migration playbook
